sourceTitle: Fables of Infidelity and Facts of Faith Being an Examination of the Evidences of Infidelity
description: "Fables of Infidelity and Facts of Faith" by Robert Patterson is an examination of the evidences against infidelity written in the late 19th century. The work critically addresses the arguments of atheism and challenges various scientific theories, such as evolution, asserting that belief in a Creator and the Bible is vital for moral and intellectual life.
